notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Version 1.0.1 is now available!
This update focuses on resolving several bugs reported by players and improving the overall game experience. We've polished areas that needed attention, ensured better stability, and added some minor tweaks to make your adventure smoother.[/p][p]Your feedback has been incredibly valuable — thank you for helping us make the game better with every step![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685022/472f46e71c6d1a31b72995899b532540ada207c0.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Hollow Lighthouse Has Arrived
notes.content:
[p]The wait is over. [i]The Hollow Lighthouse[/i] is now available on Steam!
Dive into a narrative-driven mystery adventure set on a remote, fog-shrouded coast. As the new keeper of the lighthouse, you’ll uncover dark secrets hidden beneath the waves and confront a haunting presence that refuses to be ignored.
Will you restore the light—or vanish into the hollow?
Download now and begin your descent into the unknown.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685022/ea6032d7ff11556492e8f22c6dd91c64b70f8aac.png"][/img][/p]
